2.english_reference: A Psalm of David , when he fled from Absalom his son .

2.english_reference: LORD , how are they increased that trouble me !

traditions.LXX: Κύριε , τί ἐπληθύνθησαν οἱ θλίβοντές με ?
traditions.VUL: Dómine quid multiplicáti sunt qui tríbulant me ?

2.english_reference: many [ are ] they that rise up against me .

traditions.KJV: many [ are ] they that rise up against me .

3.english_reference: Many [ there be ] which say of my soul

traditions.KJV: Many [ there be ] which say of my soul , [ There is ]

3.english_reference: [There is] no help for him in God

Selah .

traditions.KJV: I cried unto the LORD with my voice ,
